post.description:
确认版本附件已上传完成。在文件通过预签名 URL 上传成功后，必须调用此接口完成上传确认，附件才会正式关联到版本中。
Confirm that the release asset has been uploaded. After the file is uploaded via the pre-signed URL, you must call this endpoint to complete the upload confirmation. The asset will only be formally associated with the release after confirmation.
`upload_token` 和 `asset_path` 参数从获取上传地址接口返回的 `verify_url` 中提取。
The `upload_token` and `asset_path` parameters are extracted from the `verify_url` returned by the upload URL endpoint.
通过 `ttl` 参数设置附件保留天数（0 表示永久，最大 180 天）。
Use the `ttl` parameter to set the number of days to retain the asset (0 for permanent, max 180 days).
访问令牌调用此接口需包含以下权限。Required permissions for access token.
